package com.acme.invoicing.util;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatIllegalArgumentException;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.NullAndEmptySource;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource;

class InvoiceNumberUtilsTest {

    @Test
    void formatPadsSequenceAndAppendsCheckDigit() {
        assertThat(InvoiceNumberUtils.format("INV", LocalDate.of(2026, 10, 1), 123))
                .isEqualTo("INV-202610-0001230");
    }

    @ParameterizedTest
    @ValueSource(longs = {0L, -5L})
    void formatRejectsNonPositiveSequence(final long seq) {
        assertThatIllegalArgumentException()
                .isThrownBy(() -> InvoiceNumberUtils.format("INV", LocalDate.of(2026, 10, 1), seq));
    }

    @ParameterizedTest
    @NullAndEmptySource
    @ValueSource(strings = {"INV-2026-0001230", "inv-202610-0001230", "INV-202610-0001231"})
    void isValidRejects(final String candidate) {
        assertThat(InvoiceNumberUtils.isValid(candidate)).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void isValidAcceptsWellFormedNumber() {
        assertThat(InvoiceNumberUtils.isValid("INV-202610-0001230")).isTrue();
    }

    @org.junit.Test
    void checkDigitOfAllZerosIsZero() {
        assertThat(InvoiceNumberUtils.checkDigit("000000")).isEqualTo('0');
    }
}
